title: A browser-native classic Visual Basic VB6 IDE
summary: A browser-native implementation of the classic Visual Basic 6 (VB6) IDE that allows users to run and develop VB6 applications directly in a web browser using WebAssembly technology, enabling legacy code maintenance without requiring the original Windows environment.
problem_solved: Enables developers to run and maintain legacy VB6 applications without needing original Windows hardware or installing deprecated software.
why_valuable: Preserves access to millions of lines of existing VB6 business code still running in production environments, democratizing legacy system maintenance through browser accessibility.
